build.beforeBuildCommand: node src-tauri/scripts/sidecar.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/check-index.mjs dist/dyno-app/browser/index.html

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Measures, explains and tunes your PC
bundle.longDescription: Dyno measures your PC, explains why it is slow and tunes it: a background agent keeps the history, the tray icon shows the load, and nothing changes without your say-so.
